import { Component, inject, signal, output } from '@angular/core'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms'; import { ExportImportDataService, B2bProduct, BuyLead, SupplierBid } from '../../services/export-import-data.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-public-home', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule, FormsModule], template: `
K
KEYA GROUP GLOBAL TRADE HUB

100% Export Oriented Textile, Garment & Chemical Industrial Complex

🌐 Bangladesh Premier Garments & Textiles Exporter

2-Way Global B2B Trade & Sourcing Hub

International buyers can submit RFQs for custom garments & yarn, while global raw material suppliers can bid directly on Keya Group's raw cotton & chemical procurement tenders.

Annual Outbound Export
$220 Million+
Monthly Garment Output
4.5M Pcs
Global Destination Markets
35+ Countries
🔍
Group Infrastructure

Keya Industrial Divisions

Vertically integrated manufacturing facilities supplying global buyers.

100% EXPORT APPAREL

Keya Knit Composite Ltd.

Est. 1996

Vertical composite apparel manufacturing T-Shirts, Polo Shirts, Fleece Hoodies, and Sweatpants.

Monthly Capacity: 4.5M Garments Export: $120M/Year
RING SPUN YARN MILLS

Keya Spinning Mills Ltd.

Est. 2003

Precision ring spun combed and carded cotton yarns (Ne 20/1 to 80/1) tested to Uster Top 5% benchmark.

Monthly Capacity: 3,800 MT Yarn Export: $45M/Year
PERSONAL CARE & SOAP

Keya Cosmetics & Toiletries

Est. 1990

Global exporter of beauty soaps, glycerine, toothpaste, petroleum jelly, and laundry detergents.

Monthly Capacity: 12,000 MT Soap Export: $30M/Year
RAW MATERIAL SUPPLY

Keya Cotton & Fiber Supply

Est. 2005

International raw cotton import procurement hub sourcing Australian Pima and US raw cotton bales.

Monthly Capacity: 5,000 Bales Cotton Import/Export: $25M/Year
Product Showcase

Featured B2B Export Products

Showing {{ dataService.filteredB2bProducts().length }} Certified Export Products
@for (prd of dataService.filteredB2bProducts(); track prd.id) {
HS: {{ prd.hsCode }}
{{ prd.sellerVerificationTier }}

{{ prd.title }}

Manufacturer: {{ prd.sellerName }}

FOB Price:{{ prd.fobPriceRange }}
Min. Order:{{ prd.moq }}
}
2-Way B2B Trade & Reverse Bidding

Sourcing RFQs & Supplier Reverse Tenders

@if (activeTradeTab() === 'BUYER_RFQS') {
🌐 International buyers can post custom garment requirements here. Keya Export Desk will review and negotiate deals.
@for (lead of getBuyerRfqs(); track lead.id) {
{{ lead.leadCode }} {{ dataService.formatValue(lead.targetUnitPriceUSD) }} / Unit Target

{{ lead.title }}

Buyer: {{ lead.buyerName }} (🌐 {{ lead.destinationCountry }})
Qty Required: {{ lead.quantityNeeded }}

{{ lead.specifications }}

}
} @if (activeTradeTab() === 'KEYA_TENDERS') {
🔨 Raw Material Suppliers: View Keya Group procurement tenders below and click "Place Supplier Bid" to submit your competitive pricing!
@for (tender of getKeyaTenders(); track tender.id) {
{{ tender.leadCode }}

{{ tender.title }}

Issued by: Keya Group Raw Material Import Desk
Target Budget:
{{ dataService.formatValue(tender.targetUnitPriceUSD) }} / Unit
Required Volume:{{ tender.quantityNeeded }}
Port of Delivery:CIF Chattogram Port (CGP)
Tender Deadline:{{ tender.expiryDate }}

Tender Specifications: {{ tender.specifications }}

Active Supplier Bids Received ({{ getBidsForTender(tender.leadCode).length }})
@for (bid of getBidsForTender(tender.leadCode); track bid.id) {
{{ bid.supplierCompanyName }} {{ dataService.formatValue(bid.offeredUnitPriceUSD) }} / Unit
Lead Time: {{ bid.deliveryLeadTimeDays }} Days • Status: {{ bid.status }}
}
}
}
Logistics Suite

Container Freight Load Calculator

Total Calculated Volume:
{{ getCalcCbm().toFixed(2) }} CBM
40FT HC Container Utilization: {{ (getCalcCbm() / 76.4 * 100).toFixed(1) }}%
@if (showPostRfqModal()) {

Post Custom Buy Requirement (RFQ)

} @if (showBidModal()) {
Keya Procurement Tender Bid

Submit Supplier Quote Proposal

@if (selectedTenderForBid()) {
{{ selectedTenderForBid()?.title }}
Target Price: {{ dataService.formatValue(selectedTenderForBid()?.targetUnitPriceUSD || 0) }} / Unit
}
} @if (showInquiryModal()) {

Send Direct Trade Inquiry

}
` }) export class PublicHomeComponent { dataService = inject(ExportImportDataService); onOpenAdmin = output(); activeTradeTab = signal<'BUYER_RFQS' | 'KEYA_TENDERS'>('BUYER_RFQS'); showPostRfqModal = signal(false); showBidModal = signal(false); showInquiryModal = signal(false); selectedProductForInquiry = signal(null); selectedTenderForBid = signal(null); // RFQ Form newLeadTitle = ''; newLeadQty = ''; newLeadCountry = ''; // Bid Form bidCompanyName = ''; bidUnitPrice = 3.75; bidLeadTime = 14; bidEmail = ''; bidPhone = ''; bidProposal = ''; // Inquiry Form inquiryName = ''; inquiryEmail = ''; inquiryMessage = ''; // Calc Form calcQty = 800; calcL = 60; calcW = 40; calcH = 40; getBuyerRfqs(): BuyLead[] { return this.dataService.buyLeads().filter(l => l.type === 'BUYER_RFQ' || !l.type); } getKeyaTenders(): BuyLead[] { return this.dataService.buyLeads().filter(l => l.type === 'KEYA_TENDER'); } getBidsForTender(tenderCode: string): SupplierBid[] { return this.dataService.supplierBids().filter(b => b.tenderCode === tenderCode); } getCalcCbm(): number { return (this.calcL * this.calcW * this.calcH * this.calcQty) / 1000000; } scrollToSection(id: string) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); } openInquiryModal(product: B2bProduct) { this.selectedProductForInquiry.set(product); this.showInquiryModal.set(true); } openBidModal(tender: BuyLead) { this.selectedTenderForBid.set(tender); this.showBidModal.set(true); } submitBuyLead() { if (!this.newLeadTitle) return; this.dataService.postBuyLead({ title: this.newLeadTitle, quantityNeeded: this.newLeadQty || '10,000 Pcs', destinationCountry: this.newLeadCountry || 'Germany' }); this.showPostRfqModal.set(false); this.newLeadTitle = ''; } submitSupplierBid() { if (!this.bidCompanyName) return; this.dataService.placeSupplierBid({ tenderCode: this.selectedTenderForBid()?.leadCode || 'TENDER-801', supplierCompanyName: this.bidCompanyName, offeredUnitPriceUSD: this.bidUnitPrice || 3.75, deliveryLeadTimeDays: this.bidLeadTime || 14, proposalDetails: this.bidProposal || 'Full ICA Quality Compliance', contactEmail: this.bidEmail || 'supplier@trade.com', contactPhone: this.bidPhone || '+61 7 3000 8888' }); this.showBidModal.set(false); this.bidCompanyName = ''; this.bidProposal = ''; } submitInquiry() { if (!this.inquiryMessage) return; this.dataService.sendInquiry({ subject: `Inquiry for ${this.selectedProductForInquiry()?.title || 'Product'}`, message: this.inquiryMessage, senderName: this.inquiryName || 'Buyer Representative', senderEmail: this.inquiryEmail || 'buyer@trade.com' }); this.showInquiryModal.set(false); this.inquiryMessage = ''; } }
